_comment: One edition a month. Edit this file and summary.html, then run: python3 scripts/build-summary-pdf.py. The counts come from site/data/build.json; every quoted line is checked against site/report.html (or the KJV) before anything is written.
label: October 2026
this_month: Section XV's dated current-events updates run through 23 October; since October each item is read at a named outlet or in a primary document, and every figure says whose count it is.
The test cases moved up to Section XXIII, so the report now closes on the counter-architecture, the signal and three completed things.
The map draws its connection lines by their grade: dotted for analogy or correlation, dashed for contact, solid for a documented material relationship or stronger.
Section I gained two more accounts of the author's testimony, in his words and graded as testimony.
Section XVI's comparison with other countries was rebuilt: fourteen access laws, read in their own texts, then more than twenty programmes run in secret, each with where its record sits now.
